evals.prompt: Build a Form 331 site inspection report with ten portrait site photos, long captions, four photos per page, and no signature block.
evals.expected_output: A Word and PDF report whose photo section is paginated as 4, 4 and 2 photos, with every caption kept with its photo and no trailing caption-only page.
assertions: The Word document contains ten photos and ten captions.
The photo section uses three explicit photo-page tables containing 4, 4 and 2 photos.
Two ordinary page breaks separate the photo-page tables.
The PDF contains no blank or caption-only trailing page.
